dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Gotta focus... Fishing, like life, can be ruined by a single moment of carelessness...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy some fishing supplies...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Oh, of course. It's important to be well-prepared when fishing... just as in life... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: ...Only focusing on the win won't get you over the finish line. And that's a terribly narrow way to measure life, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Just look at me... I've lost an avenue of honest work and my wife's tender loving care, but I've won it all back in the tranquility that fishing brings me...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Oh, it's no problem at all. It's not as if the fish are swarming to my line or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Hehe... Harder than it looks nowadays! And who'd sell you fishing supplies if I were to pack it up and go?

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: It's not like I'm starving and destitute. We'll get by somehow. Fishing is about the fishing, not the fish, and life is about living, not just existing...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Err, what I mean to say is that both fish and life are better well-done.

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Absolutely... Sure would be nice if I got a bite, though.
